_comment: Optional. Copy this file to capstone.config.json in the same folder as START-CAPSTONE-SETUP.cmd to make a run completely unattended with no setup question at all. The engine also writes its own copy to C:\ProgramData\CapstoneProvisioner\config\capstone.config.json after the first run, so a selection made once is reused on every later run.
_node_number: 3 to 15. Determines the private Ethernet address 192.0.2.N and nothing else. It does NOT imply anything about this machine's RAM. 1 is the coordinator and 2 is the GPU workstation; both are refused as provisioning targets.
_model_profile: CPU8, CPU16, CPU32, GPU or EMBEDDINGS. Independent of node_number: any profile may be used on any node. Choose it from this machine's actual installed RAM.
_bind_mode: PrivateLan binds 0.0.0.0:11434 and restricts inbound access to the coordinator with a scoped firewall rule; loopback keeps working. PrivateOnly binds only 192.0.2.N:11434, which is tighter but gives up loopback access on the head. See docs/SECURITY-NOTES.md.
_ethernet_mac: Leave empty for automatic adapter selection. Set it only if this machine has two or more wired network ports and the provisioner reports AMBIGUOUS_NETWORK_ADAPTER. Any format works, for example '02-00-00-00-00-01' or 'c853 09a7414b'.
_ethernet_name: Alternative to ethernet_mac: the exact Windows adapter name, for example 'Ethernet 2'. ethernet_mac is preferred because an adapter name can be renamed.
